generated_at_note: Fixed build timestamp so every output is byte-identical across reruns.

hash_function.name: hashIndexTo01 / forestRandom integer hash
hash_function.description: uint32 xor with imul(seed,0x9e3779b1), avalanche multipliers 0x21f0aaad and 0x735a2d97, normalized by 2^32

alpha_threshold.coordinate_convention: top-left origin; production target x0/y0 inclusive and x1/y1 exclusive; BRL source alphaTightBounds inclusive

excluded_source_yaw.reason: Both BRL side cells at yaw 225 are backlit/desaturated high-contrast outliers, so they are omitted without recolouring the baked pixels.
excluded_source_yaw.comparison_note: All other side yaw medianS values are 0.462963-0.571429 and microStdev32 values are 23.425150-30.421184; yaw 225 is the sole excluded yaw.

composition.alpha_compositing: straight-alpha sources sampled and accumulated in premultiplied source-over space; straight RGBA8 output
composition.x_placement_rule: Even slot centers across target tight width plus seeded jitter within +/-0.36 slot widths.
composition.y_jitter_rule: Layer ground baseline plus deterministic seeded jitter: back +/-0.1350, middle +/-0.1000, front +/-0.0600, foreground +/-0.0250 target tight heights. This exposes distinct crown domes and dips while retaining a dense bottom closure row.
composition.source_selection_rule: A/B alternate by target cell and crown ordinal; side yaw cycles by target yaw, ordinal*3, layer, and target cell index across the 7-yaw non-225 pool.
composition.affine_fit_rule: Bilinear independent-axis scale/translate from threshold-tight working bounds to production exclusive-max target bounds, followed by four real-sample edge witnesses and exact assertion.

top_silhouette.method: For every x in the target tight bounds, the first alpha >= 8 row is sampled; standard deviation and peak-to-trough are in atlas pixels with top-left origin.
